newsitem.title: USA: Sun Health to buy Alpha stake.
newsitem.headline: Sun Health to buy Alpha stake.

text.p: Sun Healthcare Group Inc said on Wednesday it intended to acquire a minority interest in the Australian company Alpha Healthcare Ltd for about US$12 million.
Alpha will use the proceeds to finance its acquisition of Health Care Corp Pty Ltd, a private hospital operator in Australia, Sun Healthcare said.

"This investment represents an opportunity for Sun to leverage its clinical expertise in an emerging healthcare marketplace," said Sun Healthcare's chief executive Andrew Turner, referring to the sub-acute care that Australia's private hospitals often provide.
Sun currently provides sub-acute care as one of its services to the long-term care industry in the United States.
